# WO-238 handoff

The executor's judgment of each acceptance criterion after the repair of
[VER-001](../../verifications/WO-238/VER-001.md), the review ladder's counts,
the actor attestation and the session's usage. The decisions are in
[decisions.md](decisions.md), the repair's from WO-238-D031 on; its evidence is
in [repair-001](repair-001/README.md).

## Criteria

**Criterion 1:** met — `scripts/lib/document-kinds.mjs` `documentKinds` classifies every tracked document under the configured roots and the root Markdown files as standing, record or generated by its path class, a generated marker line, the kinds of the paths the kit's own commands write, or the overrides in `docs/control/documents.json`, which decide first (WO-238-D001, WO-238-D034); scripts/test-docs-check.mjs "every document is standing, record or generated by its path, a marker line or the override list" covers the kit paths with no override row and an override over one; scripts/test-launchpad-export.mjs "[document] WO-238 criteria 1 and 9: an exported instance gives its seeds and first order core's kinds, and its seeds state where history and the kit's explanation live" compares the instance's eight seeds, its first order and the kit paths with core's kinds, and runs in the document gate (WO-238-D024).

**Criterion 2:** met — `readerBindings` names each standing document's entry points, the reachable standing or generated pages that link it and the programs that read it. Every link resolves by the one reference resolution the document check uses (WO-238-D031, WO-238-D035), and a program binds a document only by a reference that names it and no other: its whole path as a complete token, its root's key with its path, or a literal no other document shares (WO-238-D034, WO-238-D038, WO-238-D039); scripts/test-docs-check.mjs "a reader binding is an entry point, a link from a reachable standing or generated page, or a program that reads it; a record binds nothing", "a program binds the document its reference names and no other: …" and "a reference names one document for every reader: …"; the fixtures' standing pages with no entry point, no inbound link and no exact program reference are reported UNBOUND.

**Criterion 3:** met — `scripts/lib/document-census.mjs` counts the sessions that read each document from the Claude and Copilot journals over the last N annotated DotLn releases (N from `documentCensus.releases` in `docs/control/budgets.json`, default five), labels Codex unobserved, counts a read of a moved document's old path for the moved document, and reports an unavailable window rather than counting every journal when the release tags cannot be read (WO-238-D003, WO-238-D034, WO-238-D035); `npm run plan -- documents` lists the red tags, the unbound documents a session still reads, the unread bound ones, the records an entry point names by their path or an old path the move map lists (VER-001 F1), and the tags open past one pass, paged at 8 KB with a revision-bound `next`; scripts/test-plan-refutation.mjs "WO-238 the read census counts each document's sessions over the last N releases from the journals, labels Codex unobserved, and plan documents pages its rows at 8 KB with next"; scripts/test-docs-check.mjs "a reference names one document for every reader: …", "an unreadable release history makes the census window unavailable: …" and "red tags follow the order passes ran in, and a newer pass carries or disposes every open tag".

**Criterion 4:** met — `scripts/docs-check.mjs` fails an entry point that names a record, by its path or through the move map, a red tag open past one pass and a file at a path the move map lists as moved, and reports each standing document with no reader binding (WO-238-D004, WO-238-D031, WO-238-D035); `docs/control/doc-ceilings.json` is deleted and no ceiling is read (WO-238-D005); scripts/test-docs-check.mjs "the docs check refuses an entry point that names a record, reports an unbound standing document and refuses a red tag older than one pass without a disposition", "a reference names one document for every reader: …" and "a product document's bytes are reported and judge nothing: no ceiling, no overage advisory, and a ceiling file left behind is not read"; scripts/test-launchpad-export.mjs "the exported instance checks runtime, coordination records and explicit diagnostics separately" runs the fixture instance's `npm run test:docs`; this repository's `npm run test:docs` result is under criterion 13.

**Criterion 5:** met — the six role roots on each host state the extended standing-document clause and the reviewer's checklist item from `packages/skeleton/src/loadouts/contributor.ts`; `packages/skeleton/fixtures/wo238-role-baseline.json` pins every role over the WO-250 oracle with the chain intact (scripts/test-process-debt.mjs, scripts/test-gate-followups.mjs); WO-238-D006 records each root's cold-start bytes before and after, with `docs/evidence/WO-238/cold-start-before.json` and `cold-start-after.json`. The repair changes no role source, and `npm run sync` reports the harness and the role oracle current.

**Criterion 6:** met — `packages/skeleton/src/loadouts/entropy-reducer.ts` adds the `documents-and-readers` lens (WO-238-D008); scripts/test-entropy-review.mjs "WO-238 the reducer compiles the documents-and-readers lens under every admitted route, and a fixture episode finds the standing document that carries a dated history".

**Criterion 7:** met — the twelve filed packets carry `deliveredBy` naming the order and release that carried each (scripts/test-docs-check.mjs "WO-238 the twelve filed packets name the order and the release that carried each, as the release tags record", in the document selection since WO-238-D034); a route disposal writes the field, naming the published release, the merged order's prepared release or none while the order is in flight, and its packet edit and control events land together (scripts/test-entropy-review.mjs "the fake transport drives review, receipt, refute, refutation-receipt and dispose end to end"); a close of a carrying order completes the release before it publishes: release close judges every packet routed to the order with the release surfaces and refuses, publishing no tag and no Release, while one names another release, and the route run again from a planning branch of main writes the release the close then publishes (scripts/test-release.sh release case `routed_after_preparation`, which fails on the verified code; VER-001 F2, WO-238-D032).

**Criterion 8:** met — `scripts/work-orders.mjs` renders the card without the Cost paragraph and the order file keeps its Cost field (WO-238-D010); scripts/test-work-orders.mjs "plain-text checklist first, complete details once per file, sorted sections, safe Markdown and deterministic bytes"; `npm run work-orders -- index --check` passes as the document gate's `index` row.

**Criterion 9:** met — scripts/test-launchpad-export.mjs "[document] WO-238 criteria 1 and 9: …" exports an instance at the head whose repository-profile seed has `Current at:` and no `Checked:` field, whose workstream seed states that its members hold the history, whose root instruction block carries one residue line per profile (packages/compiler/test/harness.test.ts "the shared instruction carries one residue line per profile, naming once the rules that share a reason") and whose README states what the instance is, how to start and where the kit's documents are, with the kit's explanation in its own `docs/KIT.md` (WO-238-D007, WO-238-D011).

**Criterion 10:** met — the 51 dated planning documents, the retired copy of the planning map and the release-history notes moved by `git mv` to `docs/planning/passes/`, listed in `docs/control/document-moves.json`; records keep their bytes, every link resolves directly or through the declared map by the one resolution every reader uses, and a moved path is never reused, so the document check reports no link failure (WO-238-D002, WO-238-D012, WO-238-D022, WO-238-D031, WO-238-D035); the planning root holds standing documents, `passes/`, the generated pages and `refutations/`, its own configured root; the plan gate passes over 62 receipts in `node scripts/test-plan-refutation.mjs --check-only`, the plan check the document selection runs; after `npm run plan -- followups --sync` the register holds the base's 18 missing-source rows, each with a closing disposition, and no new one. The repair's review rounds read "no link breaks" as a link a Markdown viewer follows; on that reading the moved records' relative links and the links to old paths in work orders and product 07's goal section break, and no candidate meets it without changing records' bytes or refilling the planning root, so the map reading WO-238-D002 records and VER-001 applied is the one judged here, with the disagreement recorded for the verifier (WO-238-D036, WO-238-D037, WO-238-D039; FUP-712bb6562937332a, FUP-55580981022d6dd5).

**Criterion 11:** met — product 07 keeps the sections roles and skills cite; `docs/product/operator-reference.md` holds the session commands and the drive stop procedure; `docs/planning/passes/execution-guide-record.md` holds the moved dated accounts (WO-238-D013 records the census of sections and the bytes before and after); `npm run publication:check` passes with the edition locks `npm run sync` re-minted after the repair's product 07 edits.

**Criterion 12:** met — WO-238-D014 records the first census with its duration and its 27 red tags, and this order removes no document; the repair adds its evidence and removes none.

**Criterion 13:** met — product 07, `docs/AI-HARNESS-SECURITY.md`, `docs/KIT.md` and the reducer guide state the mechanism as built, the repair's reference rule, the no-reuse rule, the kit kinds and the close refusal included; `npm run publication:check` passed; the complete run `npm test -- --review --keep-going`, which selects every product row `npm test` runs and adds the changed machinery rows, passed at 2026-11-03T15:37:45Z with 119 fresh suites, none failed or unrun, in 0 h 51 min (3,088,949 ms; code identity `5813fed9602dd97c047875cd8441271c35b8ce2ca7a0864f10a32268d63ede2f`, tree `374d01e4f87f72c63e7d92cded36157573f91595`); `npm run test:docs` passed at 2026-11-03T15:41:55Z with 27 passed, 0 failed and 27 fresh tasks in 0 h 2 min (116,983 ms); `git diff --check` is clean against the merge base; `package.json` and `package-lock.json` add no dependency.

## Review

self-review: found 12; fixed 10; recorded 2; rounds 3; unreviewed 31 lines (the round-3 token fix, 12 lines in scripts/lib/document-kinds.mjs and 19 in scripts/test-docs-check.mjs, made after the last round and judged by the complete run)

The repair's ladder ran on Codex (WO-238-D017) in docs/control/local/reviews/WO-238/repair-3/. Round 1, three briefs over the whole diff against the merge base (round-1-criteria.md, round-1-design.md, round-1-consistency.md), reported nine findings, three blocking; seven were fixed and two recorded (WO-238-D034, WO-238-D037). Round 2, each reviewer rechecking its own findings (round-2-criteria.md, round-2-design.md, round-2-consistency.md): six of nine rechecks held; two new criterion breaks were admitted and fixed, and the two recorded findings were re-raised and kept recorded (WO-238-D038). Round 3, one combined review since the round-2 tree (round-3-combined.md): one finding fixed after the last round and one restating the recorded pair (WO-238-D039). Recorded, not fixed: moved records' relative links and product 07's goal-section links do not resolve in a Markdown viewer (WO-238-D036, WO-238-D037).
